competing_explanations: Native shared NGRAM is already at the 11-draft ceiling after corpus warmup.
The repetitive endpoint output exaggerates output-history predictability.
Prompt or output lookup overhead outweighs any saved target pass.
entries.evidence_scope: Exact endpoint token rows plus captured GPQA prompt/output rows; deterministic CPU replay.
entries.falsifier: Less than 20% fixed target-row reduction on either useful scope.
entries.mechanism: Select a longer exact proposal chain from prompt or current-output history, falling back to native BFS NGRAM.
entries.next_measurement: Run the content-bound replay and compare fixed verifier rows per emitted token.
entries.observation: The qualified NGRAM endpoint still needs target passes; proposal acceptance is the remaining multiplicative lever.
